options.why: The sentinel does not reorder any input heights; it supplies a final low boundary.
A final zero forces all remaining nonnegative-height candidates to be evaluated, including an increasing suffix.
Zero-height rectangles can still have zero area; the sentinel does not make areas positive.
Equal-height consolidation already occurs during normal processing; the sentinel also flushes unequal positive heights.

items.explanation: Increasing suffix candidates otherwise remain pending.
